description: Manual championship-value risk adjustments for exceptional current-season risks not represented in FantasyPros projections/rankings. Adjustments are applied after base C-AVI calculation and before team/player reports are generated.

players.reason: Current-season availability volatility from meaningful injury history plus off-field risk is not represented by the projection/ranking-only C-AVI inputs.
players.review: Reassess when availability/risk profile materially changes.
